title: Multiplication by a fixed left factor preserves <=
statement: For naturals a, b, c: if b <= c then a*b <= a*c.

formal.statement: theorem Nat.mul_le_mul_left : ((x0 : AxNat) -> ((x1 : AxNat) -> ((x2 : AxNat) -> ((x3 : AxNat.le x1 x2) -> AxNat.le (AxNat.mul x0 x1) (AxNat.mul x0 x2)))))

evidence.supports: Nat.mul_le_mul_left is admitted by the trusted kernel gate with the type recorded in formal.statement.
evidence.checker_command: test "$(cargo run -q -p axeyum-lean-kernel --example nat_theorem_inventory -- Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2>/dev/null | grep -Ec '^Nat\.mul_le_mul_left[[:space:]]')" -ge 1
evidence.notes: `build_nat_prelude` admits this theorem only through the trusted kernel gate, so a successful build IS the type-check; the command both performs it and prints the admitted type, which is copied verbatim into formal.statement.
